text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Committed to learning more about<n>party culture for
Helios's sake, I go<n>out into town on my day off. I
walk<n>around until I pass by a set of merry<n>voices.

text_block_list.name: Girlie A
text_block_list.text:
No cap! They dead-ass put a whole<n>cake on my
parfait!

text_block_list.name: Girlie B
text_block_list.text:
What is this, calorie overload?! Wait<n>up though, the
camera eats first. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Figuring this could be a good<n>conversation starter
with Helios, I<n>walk into a dessert shop overflowing
with style-savvy girls, only to find...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa, wild seeing you here! What up,<n>T-Rain?
choice_data_list: Just wanted to check out the menu.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The menu? Oh! You're here to solo<n>the Devil's
Cake-Parfait Challenge,<n>aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You're taking your training so<n>seriously! I'm
high-key proud of you!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't exactly my plan, but it's<n>true that I
want to better understand<n>Helios's culture.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You guys haven't met Tray-Tray<n>yet, right?!
Lemme introduce you!<n>C'mon, listen up!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
This is my trainer, who's also a
party-animal-in-training! Say hi!

text_block_list.name: Girlie A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, for real?! You're a partying<n>trainer?! We
talking the big PT?!

text_block_list.name: Girlie B
text_block_list.text:
Wanna eat with us, PT? It'll be fun<n>and crazy
grammable!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: C'mon, eat, eat! Pow, pow, boom! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I find myself attempting the challenge<n>with Helios
and her friends, until<n>eventually...

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: All done, wahey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Girlie A
text_block_list.text: Mmkay, Heliboss. We're gonna go<n>train, so later!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Go off! Rock that energy! Run it down<n>till you drop!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And? What about you, T-Rain? Gonna<n>head back to
the academy?
choice_data_list: I ate too much, so I think I'll take a break...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bet! ☆ Well, wanna hang once you're<n>done with
that? I'll show you around<n>some vibey places!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Which shade for your makeup... It's<n>gotta be this
one! You gave off<n>serious blue undertones when
we<n>first met, T-Rain!

text_block_list.name: Girlie C
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Heli-poo, are you on a date?Living the teenage dream!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real! Low-key a drip-over date!<n>Wanna doll up
my trainer with me?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna get some new makeup,<n>a new fit, and
hit the club like<n>p-p-pow! ☆

text_block_list.name: Girlie D
text_block_list.text:
Sounds fun! Lemme in on this! I'm<n>crazy good at
makeup, trust me!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yass, queen! Lucky you, Tray-Tray!<n>Nothing beats
help from a homie! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We go to a dance club after Helios<n>and her friends
manage to turn me<n>into the spitting image of a party
animal—at least, on the outside.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Here's DJ Helios's Dub!<n>Vibes! Mix! ☆
Give it up for me!

text_block_list.name: Clubber
text_block_list.text:
Hey, yo! We were waiting for Helios<n>to claim her
seat, 'cause now we can<n>turn it up and drop the
beat!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yo, yo! Okay! ☆ I'm ready to start, so<n>pump up the
vibes 'cause I'm<n>coming straight for your heart!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy, wahey! ☆ You having a good<n>time, T-Rain?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey, that's the spirit! Gimme another<n>wahey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The club is packed with young,<n>energetic people, all
of whom are<n>revolving around Helios.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She looks perfectly in her element,<n>like a fish in the
vast ocean. Learning<n>about party culture might
really help<n>me help her.
choice_data_list: (I have to keep up with the vibes!)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Heeey, you alive?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You went way too hard, T-Rain! I<n>guess the good
vibes were sending<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You're still fresh to this kinda stuff,<n>remember? You
gotta take it at your<n>own pace.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her smile is bright enough to squint<n>at. But I'm here
because I want to<n>support her, not the other way
around.
choice_data_list: I'll never be a partier if I stay down now!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wha... No shooooot! You're cray,<n>T-Rain!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you're for-real trying<n>to be a party
animal! You're full<n>sending it, on god! I love that for
you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Okay, bet! Then let's start with<n>bringing up the
vibes 101! Time to<n>raise the roooof!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Lemme get in on this action! Check it!<n>☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, guuuys! Get ready for the collab<n>of DJ Helios
featuring T-Rain! ☆

text_block_list.name: Party Animals
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO!
choice_data_list: Wait, I don't know how to DJ!
Wait, I don't know how to DJ!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it! I'll show you the<n>ropes, and you
can vibe out the rest!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Party till we drop! WOOOOO! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
From there, Helios's crazy antics<n>continue to ramp
up...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
...And I'm stuck desperately flailing to<n>not fall
behind the vibes.
